name: ODOO-001 - Odoo 19 Enterprise Docker Dev Environment Setup
Description:
Set up Zammy's development environment using Docker containerized Odoo 19 Enterprise with PostgreSQL 16+ database backend, Python 3.11+, and custom addons directory. Expectation: Local dev environment running Odoo 19 with hot-reloading for custom addons.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Docker compose file configured for Odoo 19 Enterprise and PostgreSQL 16
- Python 3.11+ environment configured with Odoo 19 CLI / scaffold tools
- Custom addons directory mounted (`/var/lib/odoo/custom-addons`)
- Local dev instance running on localhost:8069 and staging instance provisioned

name: ODOO-002 - Base Odoo 19 Modules Activation & Configuration
Description:
Activate standard Odoo 19 modules: CRM, Sales, Subscriptions, Invoicing, Events, Marketing Automation, Email Marketing, Helpdesk, Knowledge, Survey. Expectation: Base Odoo 19 workflows configured for Konn3ct terminology.

Acceptance Criteria:
- All 10 core base modules installed and enabled in Odoo 19
- Company profile, default currencies (USD, NGN, KES), and tax rules configured
- User access roles established for Sales, Support, and Finance teams
- Verified navigation and module accessibility across Odoo 19 apps

name: ODOO-003 - Custom Odoo 19 Models Fields and Tags Setup
Description:
Add custom fields and tags to Odoo 19 CRM, Contacts, and Subscriptions models as specified in Volume 5. Expectation: Fields created via Python models / Odoo Studio for segmenting leads.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Created custom fields: `x_konn3ct_user_id`, `x_account_status`, `x_current_plan`, `x_customer_health_score`
- Created custom tags: `Competitor Pain Signal`, `Upcoming Event Opportunity`, `Creator Monetization`, `Replay Demand`, `Payment Recovery`, `Renewal Window`
- Verified fields and tags render on Odoo 19 Lead, Contact, and Subscription views

name: ODOO-004 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_subscriber_sync in Odoo 19
Description:
Develop custom Odoo 19 addon `konn3ct_subscriber_sync` to ingest Kay's API-026 `USER_REGISTERED` payloads. Expectation: Automatic creation/update of Contacts and Leads in Odoo 19.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Addon module structure created (`__manifest__.py`, models, controllers) in Python 3.11
- Exposes API endpoint to ingest Kay's `USER_REGISTERED` payload (User ID, Email, Country Code, Referral Code, Lead Source)
- Creates or updates Contact and Lead record in Odoo 19
- Idempotency check prevents duplicate contact creation

name: ODOO-005 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_usage_intelligence in Odoo 19
Description:
Develop custom Odoo 19 addon `konn3ct_usage_intelligence` to consume Kay's API-027 usage metric payloads (Meetings Hosted, Joined, Replays Watched, AI Notes Used). Expectation: Computes Customer Health Score (0-100).

Acceptance Criteria:
- Ingests Kay's daily activity metrics payload per user
- Calculates composite `x_customer_health_score` (0-100) dynamically in Odoo 19
- Automatically triggers an alert activity for Account Manager if health score drops below 40
- Unit tests written and passing for health score logic

name: ODOO-006 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_paid_events in Odoo 19
Description:
Develop custom Odoo 19 addon `konn3ct_paid_events` extending `event.event` and `sale.order` for webinar ticket sales. Expectation: Links ticket payment to Konn3ct room access.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Links ticket sale orders to Konn3ct room IDs
- Generates event access entitlement upon invoice payment confirmation
- Fires webhook to Kay's Konn3ct API to grant user room access entitlement
- Verified ticket purchase flow end-to-end in Odoo 19

name: ODOO-007 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_replay_monetization in Odoo 19
Description:
Develop custom Odoo 19 addon `konn3ct_replay_monetization` to track paid video replays, view access limits, and host revenue splits. Expectation: Accurately logs creator earnings.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Tracks paid replay sales and host revenue percentage split in Odoo 19
- Generates monthly creator revenue summary reports
- Webhook integration to revoke replay access when expiry date passes
- Verified revenue calculations in Odoo 19 Invoicing

name: ODOO-008 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_partner_attribution in Odoo 19
Description:
Develop custom Odoo 19 addon `konn3ct_partner_attribution` to track ambassador referral codes and Country Hub operator commissions. Expectation: Automated commission calculation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Links referral codes from Kay's payload to specific Partner/Ambassador Contact cards
- Automatically calculates commission amount on every invoice payment
- Tracks Country Hub regional revenue attributions in Odoo 19
- Monthly partner payout summary report generated

name: ODOO-009 - 4-Tier Lead Scoring Engine Implementation in Odoo 19
Description:
Configure Odoo 19 automated lead scoring rules combining Fit Score, Intent Score, Engagement Score, and Revenue Potential Score (Volume 5). Expectation: Leads automatically classified as Cold, Warm, Hot, or Strategic.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Scoring weights configured: Fit (25pt), Intent (25pt), Engagement (25pt), Revenue (25pt)
- Automated rule updates composite score upon ingesting Kay's telemetry signals
- Hot leads (Score >= 65) automatically assigned to senior salesperson
- Strategic leads (Score >= 85) trigger immediate email alert to Leadership

name: ODOO-010 - Marketing Automation Nurture Sequences Setup in Odoo 19
Description:
Configure automated email and WhatsApp nurture sequences in Odoo 19 Marketing Automation module. Expectation: Segment-specific campaigns for Free User activation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Onboarding 7-day email drip sequence for new signups
- Webinar attendance follow-up sequence with replay links
- WhatsApp template integration for high-intent leads
- Opt-out / Unsubscribe logic verified to comply with privacy rules

name: ODOO-011 - Abandoned Checkout & Payment Recovery Workflow
Description:
Configure Odoo 19 automated workflow consuming Kay's API-028 `PAYMENT_FAILED` events (including Abandoned Checkout flags). Expectation: Automated payment recovery campaigns.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Triggers on `PAYMENT_FAILED` event or abandoned checkout flag from Kay
- Dispatches payment recovery email after 1 hour and 24 hours
- Generates support follow-up ticket in Odoo 19 for high-value enterprise accounts
- Tracks recovery success rate in Odoo 19 CRM dashboard

name: ODOO-012 - Odoo 19 Helpdesk SLA & Kay's Diagnostic Link Setup
Description:
Configure Odoo 19 Helpdesk module consuming Kay's API-029 support ticket events and Diagnostic Snapshot JSON URLs. Expectation: Ticket priority mapped to user subscription tier.

Acceptance Criteria:
- SLA policies established: Paid Users (2-hour response), Free Users (24-hour response)
- Diagnostic Snapshot JSON URL field populated in Odoo 19 Helpdesk ticket view
- Automatic ticket assignment based on issue category (Billing, Technical, Account)
- Automated escalation rule triggers if SLA deadline is breached

name: ODOO-013 - Inbound XML-RPC / REST API Controller Setup in Odoo 19
Description:
Configure inbound API controllers in Odoo 19 to receive JSON events pushed by Kay's background queue workers. Expectation: Fast, authenticated endpoint handling.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoints accept JSON payloads from Kay's worker pool (`USER_REGISTERED`, `MEETING_HOSTED`, `PAYMENT_SUCCESS`)
- Authenticates API key in request header
- Returns HTTP 200 OK with record ID upon successful ingestion
- Handles error logging for invalid payloads

name: ODOO-014 - Outbound Webhook Dispatcher Configuration in Odoo 19
Description:
Configure Odoo 19 automated actions / webhooks to push state changes to Kay's Konn3ct API endpoints. Expectation: Konn3ct entitlements update when Odoo subscription/invoice states change.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Webhooks trigger on `SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED`, `TICKET_RESOLVED`
- Posts signed payload to Kay's `/api/v1/integrations/odoo/webhook` endpoint
- Includes signing secret in HTTP header for verification
- Verified outbound webhook execution in Odoo 19 logs

name: ODOO-015 - Executive BI Dashboards Configuration in Odoo 19
Description:
Configure custom reporting dashboards in Odoo 19 BI to track Free Users, Paid Users, MRR, ARR, CAC, and LTV. Expectation: Executive-ready visual reporting.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Headline KPI tiles for Total Free Users and Total Paid Users
- Financial charts for Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Subscription Renewal Rate %
- Campaign ROI dashboard tracking conversion rate by lead source
- Exportable PDF/Excel executive reports configured
